title: Create a valid student account and continue to sign in
description: Verifies that a new institutional student account can be created successfully and the app returns to the sign-in screen afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab
Fill in the full name field with Ana Maria Lopez
Fill in the institutional email field with ana.lopez.student.unique01@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 1234567890
Submit the registration form
Verify a successful registration confirmation is visible
Proceed to the sign-in screen
Verify the sign-in screen is displayed

title: Log in with a newly created account and reach the student home screen

Verify the sign-in screen is no longer displayed
